$comment: Machine-readable changelog for the canonical schemas (§13.3 requires one alongside the machine-readable schema). Each change is classified, and tools/versioning.mjs decides from these classifications whether a version bump was legal — so a breaking change recorded under an unchanged MAJOR fails the build rather than shipping.

changes.description: Add unsupported_feature for valid PDF structures the checker cannot inspect, and pdf_check_incomplete to explain failed PDF checks without claiming completed coverage.

limitationCode gains ocr_not_available. A coverage-reducing skip must be named by a limitation, and the nearest existing codes are answers from an OCR that ran - a build with no OCR could not say what it lacked.
